+++ b/src/click/type_class_key.py
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from .types import ParamType
+
+
+class TypeClassKey(ParamType):
+    """A :class:`~click.types.ParamType` whose info dict labels the
+    derived class name with the ``type_class`` key instead of
+    ``param_type``.
+    """
+
+    def to_info_dict(self) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+        """Gather information that could be useful for a tool generating
+        user-facing documentation.
+
+        Use :meth:`click.Context.to_info_dict` to traverse the entire
+        CLI structure.
+
+        .. versionadded:: 8.0
+        """
+        # The class name without the "ParamType" suffix.
+        type_class = type(self).__name__.partition("ParamType")[0]
+        type_class = type_class.partition("ParameterType")[0]
+
+        # Custom subclasses might not remember to set a name.
+        if hasattr(self, "name"):
+            name = self.name
+        else:
+            name = type_class
+
+        return {"type_class": type_class, "name": name}
diff --git a/tests/test_type_class_key.py b/tests/test_type_class_key.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..cea5473
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_type_class_key.py
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+from click.type_class_key import TypeClassKey
+
+
+def test_to_info_dict_uses_type_class_key():
+    class CustomParamType(TypeClassKey):
+        name = "custom"
+
+    assert CustomParamType().to_info_dict() == {
+        "type_class": "Custom",
+        "name": "custom",
+    }
+
+
+def test_to_info_dict_without_name():
+    class OtherParameterType(TypeClassKey):
+        pass
+
+    assert OtherParameterType().to_info_dict() == {
+        "type_class": "Other",
+        "name": "Other",
+    }
